title: miguel-torres-private-deploy-field-notes
content:
Daily scratchpad - private deploys (notes to self)

2026-03-03: quick field notes from call with ACME Health (on-prem, air-gapped site)
Owner: Miguel Torres
Context: POC install next week. Their infra: 3 x r5.8x + 2 x nvidia a10 (hosted in colo), internal firewall + corporate proxy, FIPS KMS (HSM) requirement.

Top concerns / blockers
- Customer insists on FIPS-compatible KMS + HSM — need to verify our Private k8s operator supports HSM (PKCS#11) flows.
- Proxy-only egress: our installer currently pulls images from docker hub by default. Need offline image bundle + instructions for private registry.
- SELinux enforcing on nodes (RHEL 8) — ensure container runtime config and volume mounts accounted for.
- NFS storage: customer will provide NFS server, but CSI driver version mismatch potential. Confirm CSI versions.
- Firewall rules: ports we need: 443 (control plane), 50051 (gRPC), 3000-3100 (metrics/debug), 22 for jumpbox only. Confirm CIDR ranges.

Pre-install checklist (first pass)
- [ ] Gather VPC/network design + CIDRs (ask netops for BGP/VLANs)
- [ ] Get list of bastion IPs for SSH + jumpbox cert pubkey
- [ ] Confirm private registry endpoint + auth method (user/password or mTLS)
- [ ] Prepare offline image bundle: list images used by operator + runtime (redwood-runtime:vX, sidecars)
- [ ] Validate KMS integration steps with security (HSM PKCS#11).
- [ ] Confirm storage class name and access mode for inference PVs.
- [ ] Validate required kernel modules for A10 drivers and NVMe storage.

Install notes / commands to try
- Create namespace + CRDs:
  kubectl apply -f redwood-crds.yaml --kubeconfig=/path/to/kubeconfig

- If behind proxy, set imagePullSecrets for registry and configure daemon.json on nodes:
  {
    "registry-mirrors": ["https://private-registry.company"],
    "insecure-registries": []
  }

- Offline image load (if air-gapped):
  # on registry host
  ctr -n k8s.io images import redwood-bundle.tar
  crictl pull private-registry.company/redwood-runtime:vX

- Helm install (operator) with KMS options:
  helm upgrade --install redwood-operator ./charts/operator \n    --set security.kms.type=pkcs11 \n    --set security.kms.pkcs11.libPath=/usr/lib/pkcs11/libhsm.so \n    --set registry.endpoint=private-registry.company \n    --set imagePullSecrets[0].name=reg-cred

Notes: some customers require setting NET_RAW capabilities off for containers — check runtimeClass if needed.

Observability / telemetry considerations
- Metrics port usually scraped by Prometheus in their monitoring stack. If on-prem has strict monitoring policy, provide an option to push metrics to customer gateway instead of open scrape.
- Logging: recommend fluent-bit sidecar -> central syslog or internal S3-compatible object store. Add sample config in repo.

Unresolved questions (send to solutions-eng before POC)
- Does our operator support PKCS#11 token hotplug / slot changes? Need to confirm lifecycle during rotate. (Action: ping security-team)
- For FIPS mode, do we need to build special runtime images? (Action: build/qa)
- What is our recommended approach for customer-managed TLS certs for internal services? Will we support cert-manager with the cluster's CA or require PV secrets?

Quick timeline for next week
- Mon: collect network CIDRs + registry creds (customer)
- Tue: produce offline image bundle + initial helm chart tweaks for proxy
- Wed: dry-run install in our staging (with SELinux enforced)
- Thu: share runbook + checklist with ACME Health ops
- Fri: on-site assist (or remote pair) — bring jumpbox + debug scripts

Debugging tips / one-liners
- Check image pull errors: kubectl -n redwood get events --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp
- View operator logs: kubectl -n redwood logs deploy/redwood-operator -c manager --tail=200
- Check node SELinux AVC denials: ausearch -m avc -ts recent

Links to internal docs / past installs
- private-deploy-runbook (Confluence) - linked in metadata
- notes from Maya Chen on RHEL + SELinux tweaks (ask Maya for exact config)
- DEPLOY-412: ACME Health pre-install ticket

Notes to self (rambling)
- Keep checklist lean. Customers always forget to open firewall to metrics port -> cause drumbeat. Add note to jump call agenda.
- If they insist on HSM, maybe propose a hybrid: KMS in VPC with VPN to HSM? But legal may push back. Raise with sales.
- Remember to include explicit step for rotating registry creds post-install (we do not want permanent shared secrets).

TODO (short):
- [ ] Draft customer-facing POC runbook (1 pager)
- [ ] Build offline image bundle v0.1 and upload to S3 for customer download
- [ ] Validate helm values for pkcs11 with security

-- Miguel
